g.title: sync
g.text: Sync request vs remote completion | refactor candidate

g.title: cycle
g.text: AutoSync only: cycle lock -> index lock

g.title: lock
g.text: index lock -> Git common-dir repo lock

g.title: init
g.text: existing remote branch: fetch/checkout then index
new remote branch: local commit -> push -> index
failed new .git removed; existing entries retained

g.title: preflight
g.text: exact repo root, no active rebase, branch
all effective push URLs private; named credentials

g.title: refuse
g.text: input retained; scheduled marker not advanced
MCP write worker waits bounded 30s for busy

g.title: dirty
g.text: scheduled dirty refusal OR commit local changes

g.title: dry
g.text: no commit, inspect, reindex or push

g.title: pull
g.text: on conflict: abort and verify no active rebase

g.title: index
g.text: prewarm keys -> open DB -> per-source scan

g.title: unknown
g.text: recovery failure is distinct; inspect before retry

g.title: local
g.text: propagate failure; no push; owned locks released

g.title: cleanup
g.text: client cancellation does not cancel MCP sync
